text: RFP_FIX | Please confirm that all copies of our policyholder data, including disaster recovery replicas, remain inside India. | Customer data is stored in India by default (AWS Mumbai), but disaster recovery copies are held in Singapore. Customers who need all copies of their data kept in India should discuss this with Nimbus Labs before signing. | Riya Sharma

RFP_FIX | Do you report cyber incidents to CERT-In, and within what time? | Nimbus Labs reports to CERT-In within 6 hours of becoming aware of a reportable cyber incident, as required by Indian rules. Affected customers are notified within 72 hours when a breach involving customer data is confirmed. | Riya Sharma
